svg.title: Epidemic control framework: models, measurements, optimal policy and interventions
svg.desc: Editable vector schematic with a central epidemic globe, SI, SIR and SEIR compartment models, prevalence measurements, an optimal control minimisation and intervention measures connected by a circular teal feedback loop.
